English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false Were 200 patients with Swine flu admitted to Lanka Hospitals? False A message circulating on WhatsApp claiming that 200 Maldivian patients with Swine flu have been admitted to Lanka Hospitals caught the attention of FactSeeker as the message claimed that 2 – 3 patients have died. by Anonymous | July 29, 2024 Observing the said claim, FactSeeker stepped in to investigate on social media. The management of the hospital had issued the following statement verifying that the allegation is false. “There is NO TRUTH to these claims. A full media brief will follow soon” the statement read. Accordingly, FactSeeker verifies that claims circulating that Maldivian patients with Swine flu have been admitted to Lanka Hospitals. We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
